task_completion.description: Agent navigated to the PDF Templates module creation page.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The browser shows the SuiteCRM interface, specifically the 'PDF Templates' module or a 'Create PDF Template' form.

task_completion.description: The template name is set to 'Federal Government Quote Template'.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Name' field in the form contains the text 'Federal Government Quote Template'.

task_completion.description: The template is assigned to the 'Quotes' module.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Type' or 'Module' dropdown selector shows 'Quotes' (internally AOS_Quotes) as the selected option.

task_completion.description: The template body contains the specific merge variables for name and total amount.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The editor body shows the exact strings '$aos_quotes_name' and '$aos_quotes_total_amount'.

task_completion.description: The template body contains the required confidentiality and FSS notice text.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The editor body contains the text: 'CONFIDENTIALITY NOTICE: This quote is subject to Federal Supply Schedule (FSS) terms and conditions. Valid for 30 days.'

task_completion.description: The template is saved and set to an 'Active' status.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The 'Status' field is set to 'Active' and the agent clicks the 'Save' button, resulting in a success message or a detail view of the saved template.

integrity.description: The agent used the SuiteCRM web interface rather than direct database manipulation or CLI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show the mouse cursor interacting with form fields and buttons within the browser.

integrity.description: The agent did not leave default 'Lorum Ipsum' or placeholder text in the template body.
integrity.visual_evidence: The template body editor only contains the requested text and variables, not generic template filler.

integrity.description: The agent navigated through the CRM menus to reach the PDF Templates module.
integrity.visual_evidence: Sequential screenshots show the agent clicking on the 'All' menu or 'PDF Templates' sidebar/tab.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The template name must be exactly 'Federal Government Quote Template'. The module type must be 'Quotes' (AOS_Quotes). The body must contain the variables '$aos_quotes_name' and '$aos_quotes_total_amount'. The disclaimer must mention 'Federal Supply Schedule' and 'Valid for 30 days'. The template status must be 'Active'.
